title: Native tokens can be drained from the Factory contract
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High. Stolen assets.  **Likelihood:** High. Any user can do it.  ## Description  An adversary can perform an attack to steal all native tokens from the Factory contract by exploiting an error in the `crossChainBuy()` function.  Here's a simplified version of the error. It's present on the `value: msg.value - fees` calculation:  ```solidity     function crossChainBuy(...) {         _buyGovernanceTokenERC20DAO(_daoAddress, _numOfTokensToBuy);          fees = ((depositFees * platformFeeMultiplier) / 100); @>      ICommLayer(_commLayer).sendMsg{value: msg.value - fees}(_co
